title: Puff-Puff
description: Soft, golden balls of sweet yeasted dough, deep-fried until puffed. The small chop everyone reaches for first.

image.alt: Tray of freshly fried golden puff-puff balls

equipment.name: Clean tea towel or cling film

ingredients.note: Up to 150 g for sweeter puff-puff

ingredients.constraint: Warm, not hot — hot water kills the yeast

steps.instruction: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, nutmeg and salt in a large bowl.
Pour in the warm water gradually and mix with your hand until you have a smooth, sticky, stretchy batter.

cues.texture: Smooth, sticky and stretchy — thicker than pancake batter.

steps.instruction: Cover the bowl and leave in a warm place to rise.

cues.visual: Doubled in size and full of bubbles.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a deep pan.

cues.sound: A small drop of batter sizzles and rises within a few seconds.

steps.safetyNote: Keep the oil at medium — too hot browns the outside before the middle cooks.

steps.instruction: With a wet hand, squeeze batter up through your fist and pinch off balls into the oil (or use two spoons). Fry, turning, until golden all over.
steps.completionNote: Break one open: the inside should be fluffy and cooked through.

steps.instruction: Drain on kitchen paper. Dust with sugar if you like and serve warm.

notes: Add a little chopped scotch bonnet to the batter for a savoury, spicy version.
